messages:
maya (product): Brain dump: propose a 'isolation band' pilot for Dedicated pools. Motivation: customers keep asking for predictable p99s during short surges. Pilot objective: let high-tier tenants opt into a small, preemptible slice that reduces interference. Need product+eng+reliability agreement on scope.

sam (eng): High level ok. Need to pick enforcement model: hard reservation vs admission tagging + throttles. Hard reservation hurts utilization.

alex (eng-platform): Prefer admission tagging + soft enforcement. Implementation: mark 'in-band' requests and prefer them in scheduler; only preempt non-in-band when band under pressure. Autoscaler should see band as soft headroom.

jordan (reliability): Observability requirements: latency by (tenant, in-band flag), preempt events, and band fill ratio. Also want a throttling histogram to detect oscillation.

lina (sales): Commercial asks: 1) customers want it as "opt-in" on contract; 2) many expect no extra $ unless they buy burst credits. We should offer two billing models for pilot: included with committed reservation (no extra per-token charge) vs token-bucket credit conversion.

sam (eng): Ops question: what's trigger for preemption? eviction when band > threshold and p95 latency across pool degraded? Or simple fill > configured percent?

maya (product): Suggest preemption chain: (1) if band exhausted, try model-variant fallback (lighter quantized/shorter context), (2) route to other region if available, (3) preempt best-effort tenants. Preemption should be last resort.

alex (eng-platform): Config knobs we need: band_percent (5-20), eligible_tiers, preempt_priority_order, fallback_chain. Example config: 
```json
{"band_percent":10,"eligible_tiers":["enterprise","priority"],"preempt_priority_order":["best_effort","spot"],"fallback_chain":["model_variant","regional_reroute","preempt"]}
```
Make it feature-flag gated per-pool.

jordan (reliability): Add safety: small cooldown after preemption events to avoid thrash. Also add automated alert if band preemptions > X/hour.

lina (sales): For pilot customers I'll propose included-with-commit option and a paid-burst-credit option. Need clear SLA language: "band reduces p99 latency under spikes but is preemptible; we recommend reserved commit for full guarantee."

sam (eng): SDK signals: include response header x-rw-band-status: in-band|overflow|preempted and metric tag rw.band=true/false. That helps customer observability and internal billing.

alex (eng-platform): Billing: two possibilities: 1) meter in-band tokens at same rate as reserved, or 2) amortize band cost across pool as part of reservation (no per-token bill). For pilot, support both via config.

maya (product): Pilot success criteria (proposed): 
- pilot tenant reports p99 improvement >= 30% on peak events,
- no >10% increase in overall infra cost for us (measured vs baseline),
- no more than 3 oncall incidents caused by band interactions during pilot window,
- observability dashboard + alerting live.

jordan (reliability): Also add rollout gating: start with simulation (dry-run) -> internal canary (internal tenant) -> 1 external pilot tenant -> 2 external tenants. Each stage 1 week min.

lina (sales): I'll get two pilot customers: one prefers included option, one prefers burst-credit conversion. Both want a 4-week pilot.

sam (eng): Work items: RFC for admission + preemption logic, admission tagging PR, scheduler weighting changes, SDK header + metric, autoscaler tweaks to treat band as soft headroom. ETA: RFC by Tue EOD, small PRs following.

alex (eng-platform): I'll own feature flag, pool schema, and billing hook. Also will add metric tags for band. Need 3 dev days + 2 oncall runbook days.

maya (product): Jordan, can you draft telemetry spec and runbook items by Tue? Lina to confirm pilots by Tue. Sam+Alex to pair on RFC. I'll schedule a 30m sync Wed.

devops-bot: Note: capacity planning on Friday. If band reduces usable headroom, update the headroom targets in the planner.

maya (product): One more thing: docs. We need a short console UX: toggle band per-pool + show projected impact. Add to checklist.

sam (eng): Agreed. Quick follow-up: how to test fallback chain in canary? Need chaos tests that force model-variant fallback and region reroute.

jordan (reliability): I'll add chaos knobs to the canary harness. Also recommend a stress test with mixed tenants to validate fairness.

maya (product): Great. If there are no objections, we'll roll this as an experiment with the above checklist. Comments/edits welcome.

lina (sales): LGTM from sales side.

alex (eng-platform): LGTM.

sam (eng): 👍

jordan (reliability): 👍
